subject: general
question: The average age of 51 students in a class is 24 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 25 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
**Given:**

The average age of 51 students = 24 years

Total number of students + teacher = 52

The average age of the group (students + teacher) = 25 years

**Formula used:**

Total age = Average × Number of people

Age of teacher = Total age of group - Tota
